name: braintrust
summary: I successfully installed the Braintrust SDK (v0.30.1) and created the quickstart's `tutorial_eval.py` exactly as documented. The eval ran successfully via both the CLI (`braintrust eval --no-send-logs tutorial_eval.py`) and direct Python execution, producing the promised score report: `50.00% 'is_equal' score` with per-result breakdowns (Result 0: `is_equal: True`, Result 1: `is_equal: False`). What blocked full completion was a sandbox-level TLS connectivity issue to `www.braintrust.dev:443`—all HTTPS connections to Braintrust's API were reset during the SSL handshake, so I could not run the eval with `no_send_logs=False` to upload results to the cloud. I had to deviate from the docs by adding `--no-send-logs` to make the evaluation execute locally.
